_help: What each section of the site wants from the media library. `npm run media:report` compares this with media.json. Empty slots simply hide their section.

slots.label: Home hero slideshow
slots.hint: Landscape photos with space for a headline. No text in the image.

slots.label: Home hero background videos
slots.hint: Silent landscape loops, 10-20 seconds, calm movement.

slots.label: Video library
slots.hint: Landscape films of 1-3 minutes with clear sound.

slots.label: Gallery
slots.hint: Any good photos or short clips, tagged by topic.

slots.label: Before and after slider
slots.hint: Two photos of the same place from the same angle, named x.before.jpg and x.after.jpg.

slots.label: Video testimonials
slots.hint: About one minute, quiet place, with consent.

slots.label: Team and trustees photos
slots.hint: Portrait photos, shoulders up, plain background.

slots.label: A day at the home
slots.hint: Four photos: morning, school, play, evening. Tag each with about-day.
